name: NAL-R amplification
idea: Audiogram-conditioned frequency gain. Exact Clarity FIR is used offline; the live filter bank approximates its targets.
issue: Restores some audibility; cannot repair cochlear resolution or separate overlapping speech.

name: Wide dynamic-range compression
authors: Kates, Principles of Digital Dynamic-Range Compression
idea: Bandwise level-dependent gain maps input dynamics into a smaller output range.
issue: Fast independent-ear gain changes can affect envelopes and interaural level cues. Our parameters are illustrative, not a fitting prescription.

name: Ideal directional selection
idea: Known source direction controls a cardioid-like gain before spatial mixing.
issue: Not a beamformer. It has access to clean source stems unavailable to a real hearing aid.

name: MSBG hearing-loss model
idea: Models aspects of impaired auditory filtering and loudness recruitment for auralization.
issue: Audiogram alone does not determine pathology, cognition, or an individual listening experience.

name: HASPI / HASQI
idea: Auditory-model metrics for predicted intelligibility and quality.
issue: Objective predictions are not listening-test scores. Do not pass MSBG output through a second impairment model by accident.
status: HASPI v2 pilot measured; HASQI planned

name: Binaural MWF / MWF-N
authors: Van den Bogaert, Doclo, Wouters & Moonen
idea: Multichannel Wiener filtering trades noise reduction and spatial-cue preservation.
issue: Requires microphone geometry, covariance estimation and a fair distortion constraint. Residual noise cues matter too.

name: openMHA
idea: A research platform for assembling and evaluating hearing-aid algorithms.
issue: A framework, not one algorithm or a quality ranking. Hardware/audio-driver behavior still needs measurement.

name: DeepFilterNet
idea: Perceptual bands plus complex deep filtering; published open code and weights.
issue: Notebook real-time factor does not establish open-fit hearing-aid latency; independent mono use can alter binaural cues.

name: Deep FIR / Viking
idea: A compact recurrent network estimates time-domain FIR filters; minimum-phase conversion reduces delay.
issue: Paper reports 0.32–1.25 ms mean algorithmic latency and 3.35 ms mean end-to-end on its hardware, not in this lab.

name: Ultra-low-latency study
idea: Compares architectures and design choices under strict speech-enhancement delay constraints.
issue: A controlled latency/quality study is a better baseline-selection guide than ranking unrelated published scores.

name: RT-Tango
idea: Distributed binaural processing, compressed ERB features, grouped recurrent inference and asymmetric STFT.
issue: Abstract reports operation as low as 8 ms. Code, weights, adaptation behavior and end-to-end timing need verification.

name: Directivity-conditioned neural filtering
idea: FiLM conditioning steers directivity; cross-channel spectral constraints aim to preserve spatial relationships.
issue: Abstract reports 10 ms latency. Reproduction must test unseen head geometry, moving sources and steering errors.

name: Clarity CEC3
idea: Hearing-aid enhancement evaluation with real room responses, hearing-aid signals and dynamic backgrounds.
issue: Follow task-specific data licenses, split definitions and latency rules. Prediction challenges evaluate metrics, not enhancement systems.
